testedVersions: .NET 11; Microsoft Graph REST v1.0 synthetic HTTP fixtures only
prerequisites: A Clarity Graph connection for this producer on the tenant (multi-tenant collector app with per-customer admin consent)
Admin consent for the section application permissions listed below
Organization.Read.All to verify the observed tenant before collecting any section
limits: Synthetic HTTP tests do not certify a live tenant or Key Vault access
Graph consent does not authorize PnP.PowerShell or SharePoint Online Management Shell
Site metadata only; no file contents, permissions or sharing settings
Public Graph cloud only; tenant-wide scope; bounded ZIP v1 package sizes

testedVersions: Pester 5.7.1 with mocked PnP.PowerShell cmdlets on PowerShell 7; no live PnP.PowerShell module version is certified
prerequisites: PowerShell 7.4 or newer on an authorized workstation
PnP.PowerShell installed separately by an administrator
Client ID of a customer-authorized Entra app registration for PnP interactive sign-in, typed at launch and never stored
Signed-in account with read access to the targeted site; SharePoint administrator rights for sharepoint.siteSharing
limits: One targeted site collection URL per request (resource scope); not a tenant-wide inventory
Graph consent is unrelated: PnP uses the customer app registration and the signed-in account's rights
Metadata only; no file or list item contents

producers.apiVersion: Microsoft Graph v1.0 usage report CSV
testedVersions: Synthetic CSV fixtures of the documented Graph v1.0 getSharePointSiteUsageDetail column set (byte units)
prerequisites: Consultant upload of a report downloaded with Reports.Read.All and a Microsoft 365 reports role; tenant attested by the consultant
Or a server download through the tenant's clarity.graph.sharepoint connection with Reports.Read.All (application); tenant observed
limits: Interpreted only through report profile m365.sharePointSiteUsageDetail 1.0.0, whether uploaded or downloaded
Admin center MB exports, localized headers and multi-geo files are rejected

endpoints: GET /v1.0/sites/getAllSites (no documented query options; Clarity keeps only id, name, displayName, webUrl, createdDateTime, lastModifiedDateTime, isPersonalSite, root and siteCollection)
sections.refreshStrategy: Full tenant site snapshot per run; no delta cursor
limits: Personal (OneDrive) sites are excluded; see the onedrive family
One object per site collection keyed by its collection GUID; subsites are not collected
No permissions, sharing settings or storage volumes

sections.refreshStrategy: Full Microsoft 365 group snapshot per run; one root-site read per group
limits: Only Microsoft 365 (Unified) groups; teamsConnected comes from the group's resourceProvisioningOptions
Teams channels and private/shared channel sites are not collected
A group whose site is not provisioned or not readable is counted as GroupSiteUnavailable and has no relation

permissions: Read access to the targeted site collection for the signed-in account
endpoints: Get-PnPTenantId and Get-PnPSite -Includes Id,Url (tenant and site collection identity check before packaging)
limits: Root web only; subsites are not enumerated
storageUsedBytes is omitted and the section is Partial (SiteUsageUnavailable) when the account cannot read site usage

permissions: Read access to the targeted site collection for the signed-in account
endpoints: Get-PnPList -Includes RootFolder,HasUniqueRoleAssignments (document libraries: BaseTemplate 101, not hidden)
limits: Root web document libraries only; hidden and system lists are excluded
Library-level unique permissions are flagged, not expanded

permissions: Site collection administrator or permission to enumerate permissions on the targeted site
sections.refreshStrategy: Targeted root-web role assignment snapshot per request
limits: Root web role assignments only; item, folder and library unique permissions are not expanded
Claims other than Entra users, Entra groups and SharePoint groups are counted as PrincipalUnresolved
Effective access is not computed

sections.refreshStrategy: Targeted site setting snapshot per request
limits: Site-level sharing settings only; individual sharing links and external users are not collected
Fails explicitly without SharePoint administrator rights

permissions: Reports.Read.All (delegated or application) to download the report; delegated users also need a Microsoft 365 reports role
endpoints: Consultant upload of GET /v1.0/reports/getSharePointSiteUsageDetail(period='D7|D30|D90|D180') or (date=YYYY-MM-DD) CSV
Server download of GET /v1.0/reports/getSharePointSiteUsageDetail(period='D30') through the clarity.graph.sharepoint connection (302 to a pre-authenticated CSV URL)
sections.refreshStrategy: Report snapshot observed at the report refresh date
limits: Not a tenant-wide exhaustive site inventory; absence from a report never proves deletion
Concealed names and URLs are not converted or guessed
Site list can differ from the SharePoint admin center Active sites list
